question: In March 2025, ________ became the 28th legislature to join the National e-Vidhan Application platform.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Delhi** became the 28th legislature to join the **National e-Vidhan Application (NeVA) platform** in **March 2025**.
 
• The **National e-Vidhan Application (NeVA)** is a **mission mode project** under the **Digital India Programme** aimed at making legislative processes paperless.
 
• This platform is designed to ensure **transparency, efficiency, and accountability** in the legislative process.
 
• NeVA facilitates the digitization of proceedings, including **question papers, bills, committee reports, and discussions** in legislatures.
 
• Delhi's adoption of NeVA aligns with the government's initiative to promote **e-governance and sustainable practices**.
 
• The move contributes to reducing the usage of paper and supports **environmental conservation**.
 
• The platform provides real-time information to legislators and citizens, ensuring **better participation** in the democratic process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Odisha**__

 __
 
• Odisha is a state located in **eastern India**, known for its **rich cultural heritage and historical significance**.
 
• The state is famous for the **Jagannath Temple** in Puri and the **Kalinga War**, which influenced Emperor Ashoka to adopt Buddhism.
 
• Odisha is a major producer of **minerals**, including iron ore, coal, and bauxite.
 
 
 
• **Sikkim**__
 __
 
• Sikkim is a small state in northeastern India, known for its **natural beauty** and **Buddhist monasteries**.
 
• It is home to **Khangchendzonga National Park**, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• Sikkim is the **first Indian state to become fully organic** in agricultural practices.
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand**__
 
 
• Jharkhand is rich in **mineral resources**, especially coal, iron, copper, and bauxite.
 
• The state is known for its tribal heritage and natural landscapes, including **Betla National Park**.
 
• **Ranchi** is the capital city of Jharkhand.
